title: Each tab uses an all-white table with no alternating row shading
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Work In Progress report is open with several rows in each tab.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the column headers and the data cells in each tab.
2. Compare the background of consecutive rows.
custom_expected:
1. Each tab uses an all-white table: white column headers and white data cells.
2. There is no alternating row shading (no zebra striping).
